publication_copy.headline: THE NEXT SIX
publication_copy.body: His Majesty's Blood visits D0nkey K0ng in the leading Game of the Week candidate. El Niño reaches Slob on my Dobb’s schedule while both must fill a tight-end bye. Seven Deadly Chins visits a Mud Dogs side facing a conditional elimination game. Red Leopards and Three Dreaded Snake meet under receiver and running-back pressure; The Chili Cheesers visits ObiWan Jacoby; The LLC tests Dr. Duckhook’s changing quarterback plan.
